title: STERN (Spatio-Temporal Embedding for Real-time morphogeNesis): feature extraction and volume matching code
description: Minimal code of the STERN paper (A quantitative coordinate system for developmental dynamics): the trained network for slice features, preprocessing as in the paper, and the volume distance / matching analysis. Weights and released features are in the companion data record.
